g.text: Accuracy–simulation cost tradeoff | 6 paired cases, 5 s each
MAPE: equal weight per design point. Speedup: sum(CHIPSIM process wall time) / sum(backend process wall time).
CHIPSIM is the comparison reference; compute is shared. Wall times are single measurements under concurrent host load.
